title: Is Your Google Profile Losing You Customers?

cover.name: Ivan
cover.headline: Is Google sending guests to a *locked door*?

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: Your Google page said you were open. I drove twenty minutes.
Then he leaves a review. One wrong hour can become one star.

props.caption: One wrong hour, *one star*
props.name: Ivan
props.text: Drove 20 minutes. Google said open. The door was locked.
props.reply: So sorry, Ivan. Our hours were out of date. They're fixed, and your next coffee is on us.

scenes.say: Most owners set up Google once and forget it. But Google only knows what you tell it.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: Set up Google once and you're done
props.fact: Google only shows what you tell it: holidays, new hours, a new menu

scenes.say: Say three guests a week find the wrong hours and go somewhere else. At fifteen dollars each, that's over two thousand dollars a year.
Google says a complete profile makes guests seventy percent more likely to visit. So check your hours, holiday hours and photos every month.
